action: Roundcube urges users to upgrade to the 1.7 line as soon as possible; 1.6.22 is the last 1.6 release and 1.7 will be the only line to receive security fixes.
exec: Roundcube released 1.7.7 and 1.6.22 with security fixes; 1.6.22 is the last 1.6 release, so 1.6 users must move to 1.7 for future fixes.
plain: The Roundcube webmail project released updates 1.7.7 and 1.6.22 that fix security issues. The 1.6 series gets no further releases, so users should move to 1.7.

sources.name: Security NEXT: Roundcube security fixes, 1.6 series ends with this release (Japanese)

summary: Roundcube released security updates 1.7.7 and 1.6.22 that address several issues, according to its announcement. They include a repeat fix for HTTP request injection in the spellcheck backend, CSS-scoping and remote-content blocking bypasses in HTML email, and a repeat fix for unsafe attachment content passed to ImageMagick. The page lists no CVE identifiers and says this is the last 1.6 release.
title: Roundcube 1.7.7 and 1.6.22 fix security issues; 1.6 series ends

validation.note: Roundcube's own announcement (primary) and Security NEXT both state the 1.7.7 and 1.6.22 releases, the fixes and that 1.6.22 is the last 1.6 release.
